title: hypericum filicaule
intro: Hypericum filicaule, commonly known as St. John's Wort, is a flowering plant in the family Hypericaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antidepressant properties. The therapeutic actions of St. John's Wort include its ability to reduce symptoms of mild to moderate depression, anxiety, and sleep disorders, as well as its antimicrobial and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of St. John's Wort include hyperforin, hypericin, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
